[vc_row css=".vc_custom_1545730722243{padding-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column][themestek-custom-heading text="Residential Moving Service In Ottawa" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left"][vc_column_text]

Moving to a new home in Ottawa? It’s an exciting milestone — but without the right help, it can quickly become overwhelming. At Prestige Moving, we specialize in professional residential moving services in Ottawa that make your transition smooth, efficient, and completely stress-free. Whether you’re relocating across town, moving to Ottawa from another city, or heading out of the region, our trusted Ottawa movers handle every detail from start to finish.

Your Trusted Ottawa Residential Movers

As one of the top-rated moving companies in Ottawa, Prestige Moving has earned a reputation for reliability, professionalism, and care. We manage residential relocations of all sizes — from apartments and condos to large family homes — ensuring every move is completed safely, on time, and within budget.

Our comprehensive moving solutions include:

  • Full-service packing and unpacking

  • Careful loading and unloading

  • Secure transportation across Ottawa and beyond

  • Protective materials for furniture and fragile items

  • Optional short- or long-term storage solutions

Our goal is simple: to help you focus on enjoying your new home while we handle the heavy lifting.

Why Choose Prestige Moving for Your Ottawa Home Move?

Selecting the right Ottawa moving company can make all the difference. At Prestige Moving, we bring together years of industry experience, a highly trained team, and state-of-the-art moving equipment to deliver a seamless relocation experience.

✔ Local Expertise, Proven Results

We know Ottawa — from the narrow downtown streets to suburban neighborhoods like Kanata, Barrhaven, Orleans, and Nepean. Our movers navigate every challenge with precision, ensuring your belongings arrive safely and on schedule.

✔ Professional, Fully Insured Movers

Our Ottawa movers are background-checked, insured, and professionally trained. You can trust our team to handle your home and possessions with care and respect at every stage of your move.

✔ Transparent, Competitive Pricing

We believe in honest pricing. You’ll receive a clear, upfront quote with no hidden charges. Our rates are designed to be affordable yet premium, ensuring you get the best value for your money.

✔ Modern Equipment and Safety Standards

From clean, GPS-tracked trucks to padded moving blankets and secure straps, our team uses top-tier equipment to ensure your move is safe, efficient, and damage-free.

Personalized Planning and Moving Consultation

Every home and every client is unique — and so is every move. That’s why we start with a personalized consultation to assess your specific requirements. Our moving coordinators evaluate your timeline, property type, and inventory to create a custom moving plan that works for you.

Once we understand your goals, we’ll provide a detailed quote outlining all services, timing, and costs — with no hidden fees. You’ll know exactly what to expect before moving day arrives.

Please note: For safety and structural reasons, we currently do not disassemble or reassemble IKEA furniture due to its unique design and material constraints. For these items, we recommend using specialized IKEA assembly services.

Experience the Prestige Moving Difference

When it comes to residential moving in Ottawa, attention to detail matters. From careful handling to punctual arrivals, our service philosophy revolves around trust, efficiency, and customer satisfaction.

With Prestige Moving, you get:

  • Reliable communication from start to finish

  • On-time arrivals and precise scheduling

  • Clean, uniformed movers who respect your home

  • Safe handling of every item, large or small

  • Post-move support to ensure your satisfaction

We have been voted most recommended Ottawa moving companies, consistently earning 5-star reviews for professionalism, transparency, and care.

How Our Residential Moving Services in Ottawa Work

Moving to a new home doesn’t have to be complicated. At Prestige Moving, we’ve perfected a step-by-step residential moving process in Ottawa designed to make your relocation smooth, organized, and stress-free. From planning to unpacking, our professional movers handle every stage with precision and care — ensuring your move is completed efficiently, safely, and on time.

1. Initial Planning and Free Moving Quote

Every successful move starts with a solid plan. Once you contact Prestige Moving, our team begins by understanding your unique needs, timeline, and property type. Whether you’re moving a studio apartment, condo, townhouse, or full family home, we create a customized moving plan tailored to your situation.

During your consultation, we’ll cover:

  • Your preferred moving date and schedule

  • The size and layout of your current and new home

  • Access details such as elevators, stairs, or narrow hallways

  • Fragile, valuable, or oversized items requiring extra protection

  • Any packing or storage services you may need

You’ll receive a transparent, no-obligation quote upfront — no hidden fees, no surprises. Our mission is to make residential moving in Ottawa as predictable and cost-effective as possible.

2. Professional Packing and Labeling Services

Packing is one of the most time-consuming and stressful parts of moving — which is why our Ottawa professional movers handle it all for you. Our team arrives fully equipped with high-quality moving boxes, wrapping materials, packing tape, and protective padding to keep your belongings safe during transport.

We take extra care with fragile and valuable items, including:

  • Glassware, dishes, and kitchen appliances

  • Electronics and computers

  • Mirrors, artwork, and décor

  • Furniture and antiques

  • Clothing, bedding, and personal items

Each box is carefully labeled and organized by room, making it easier for you to unpack later. This attention to detail helps prevent confusion and ensures a faster, smoother transition into your new home.

3. Efficient Loading and Safe Transportation

When moving day arrives, our licensed Ottawa movers arrive promptly with clean, GPS-tracked moving trucks equipped with professional gear — including moving blankets, straps, dollies, and protective floor runners.

We follow a precise loading and transport protocol to keep your belongings secure during every mile of the journey:

  • Heavy and large items are anchored first for balance

  • Fragile boxes are padded and positioned on top

  • Every load is tied and stabilized to prevent shifting

  • Real-time GPS tracking keeps you informed throughout the move

Our experienced drivers are trained to handle Ottawa’s urban and suburban routes safely, ensuring your items arrive at your new location without damage or delay.

4. Careful Unloading and Optional Unpacking Services

Upon arrival, our team handles unloading and placement of all items according to your instructions. Every box and piece of furniture is brought to the correct room to save you time and energy.

For homeowners who choose our premium unpacking service, we go the extra mile — removing boxes, unwrapping items, and helping you set up essential spaces like the kitchen, living room, or bedrooms.

This means you can start settling into your new home in Ottawa immediately — without being surrounded by boxes for days.

5. Final Walkthrough and Customer Satisfaction

Before completing the job, we conduct a final walkthrough with you to ensure every item is accounted for and placed exactly where it should be. Your satisfaction is our top priority, and our crew won’t leave until you’re completely happy with your move.

Why Ottawa Homeowners Trust Prestige Moving

  • ✅ Local Ottawa experts with deep knowledge of the city

  • ✅ Fully licensed and insured movers for peace of mind

  • ✅ Transparent pricing with no hidden costs

  • ✅ Eco-friendly packing materials and reusable bins

  • ✅ Hundreds of 5-star reviews from satisfied homeowners

Whether you’re moving across Downtown Ottawa, Kanata, Orleans, or Barrhaven, we make every relocation feel effortless and organized from start to finish.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][vc_single_image image="11277" img_size="large"][vc_column_text]

Frequently Asked Questions About Residential Moving Services in Ottawa

1. How much does a residential move cost in Ottawa?

The average cost of residential moving services in Ottawa typically ranges from $500 to $1,500, depending on factors like the size of your home, distance between locations, and any additional services you choose (such as packing or storage). At Prestige Moving, we provide free, no-obligation quotes with clear breakdowns — no hidden fees or surprise charges.

2. How far in advance should I book my Ottawa movers?

We recommend booking your Ottawa residential move at least 2 to 4 weeks in advance, especially during busy seasons (May–September). Booking early ensures that you get your preferred date and allows us to properly plan your move for maximum efficiency.

3. Do you provide packing materials and packing services?

Yes. Our professional team offers full-service packing and unpacking using high-quality boxes, bubble wrap, tape, and protective materials. We handle everything from delicate glassware and electronics to furniture and artwork — so you can relax knowing your belongings are safe and secure.

4. Are your movers licensed and insured?

Absolutely. Prestige Moving is a fully licensed and insured moving company in Ottawa. Our movers are professionally trained, background-checked, and covered by liability and cargo insurance — protecting both your home and your possessions throughout the move.

5. Can you handle specialty or heavy items like pianos and gym equipment?

Yes. Our experienced movers specialize in heavy, oversized, and fragile items, including pianos, gym machines, safes, antiques, and artwork. We use specialized equipment and techniques to ensure safe, damage-free transport for even the most challenging moves.

Looking for reliable residential movers in Ottawa?
📞 Call (613) 600-4000 or visit PrestigeMoving.ca to get your free moving quote today.

Request Your Free Quote Today

If you're planning a residential move in Ottawa, trust Prestige Moving to handle it with care and expertise. Reach out to us today for a free, no-obligation quote, and let us show you why we’re one of the best moving companies in Ottawa.

Let’s make your next move a smooth one.

[vc_row css=".vc_custom_1545730722243{padding-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column][themestek-custom-heading text="Packing Services in Ottawa" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left"][vc_column_text]

When preparing for a move, packing can be one of the most stressful and time-consuming parts of the process. [vc_row css=".vc_custom_1545730722243{padding-top: 40px !important;}"][vc_column][themestek-custom-heading text="Commercial Moving Services in Ottawa" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left"][vc_column_text]

Commercial Moving Services Ottawa – Trusted Office Movers | Prestige Moving

Relocating your business isn’t just about moving desks, boxes, and office equipment — it’s about protecting your company’s productivity, reputation, and assets during one of the most critical transitions a business can face. At Prestige Moving, we understand that every hour of downtime impacts your bottom line. That’s why our commercial moving services in Ottawa are designed to provide a smooth, efficient, and stress-free relocation experience from start to finish.

Our team of trained professionals handles everything with precision — from securely packing and labeling sensitive files and electronics to transporting large office furniture, machinery, and valuable inventory. We specialize in moves for corporate offices, medical and dental clinics, retail stores, warehouses, and restaurants, offering tailored solutions to fit your exact business needs. Whether you’re relocating across Ottawa or expanding to a new facility in another city, Prestige Moving ensures your transition is fast, organized, and executed with exceptional care.

With years of experience serving Ottawa’s business community, we’ve built a reputation for reliability, professionalism, and attention to detail. Our goal is simple: to help your business move forward without missing a beat.

[/vc_column_text][vc_column_text]

Why Businesses Choose Prestige Moving

Experienced Commercial Moving Experts

Our team of professional Ottawa movers is highly trained in every aspect of commercial relocations, ensuring your business assets are moved safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption. From carefully handling fragile office electronics and confidential client files to transporting heavy furniture, specialized machinery, and sensitive equipment, we approach every project with precision and care.

Over the years, we’ve successfully completed relocations for businesses of all sizes across Ottawa — from small offices to large multi-floor corporate facilities. Our experience spans a wide range of industries, including:

  • Medical and dental clinics – Secure handling of equipment and patient records

  • Restaurants and cafés – Transporting kitchen appliances, furniture, and décor

  • Retail stores and showrooms – Moving shelving, displays, and point-of-sale systems

  • Law firms and corporate offices – Relocating confidential files and office furnishings

  • Warehouses and distribution centers – Managing bulk inventory, pallets, and logistics

No matter your industry or the scale of your move, Prestige Moving has the expertise, manpower, and specialized equipment to deliver a seamless relocation experience — on time and on budget.

Minimal Downtime, Maximum Efficiency

At Prestige Moving, we understand that every minute of downtime impacts your bottom line. That’s why we offer flexible scheduling, including after-hours and weekend moving, to ensure your business stays operational with minimal disruption.

[/vc_column_text][/vc_column][/vc_row][vc_row][vc_column][themestek-custom-heading text="" font_container="tag:h2|text_align:left"][vc_column_text]

Full-Service Commercial Relocation in Ottawa

Our commercial moving services in Ottawa cover every part of the process, so you can focus on running your business while we handle the logistics.

  • Professional packing and labeling of office supplies, files, and electronics

  • Secure handling of sensitive and confidential materials

  • Furniture disassembly and reassembly

  • Safe transportation using clean, modern trucks

  • Professional unloading and setup at your new location

  • Optional unpacking and setup assistance

Please note: We do not move or disassemble IKEA furniture due to its fragile design. For these items, we recommend a specialized IKEA moving service.

Specialized Delivery Services

At Prestige Moving, we go beyond standard commercial relocations to provide specialized delivery services tailored to the unique needs of Ottawa businesses. Whether you’re moving sensitive equipment, valuable furniture, or high-volume inventory, our team ensures every item is transported safely, efficiently, and on schedule.

Dock-to-Dock Delivery

Our dock-to-dock delivery service is ideal for companies relocating between warehouses, managing product distribution, or transferring large industrial equipment. We take care of every detail — from pickup and logistics coordination to delivery and unloading — ensuring your shipment arrives securely and on time. With precise scheduling and professional handling, you can rely on us for smooth, uninterrupted operations.

White-Glove Delivery

For items that demand extra attention, our white-glove moving service in Ottawa provides a truly premium experience. Perfect for executive offices, galleries, and luxury retail spaces, we handle fragile, high-value, or delicate pieces such as artwork, display cases, electronics, and designer furniture with the utmost care. Our trained specialists will deliver, unpack, install, and even remove packaging materials — leaving your new space ready for use.

Whether it’s executive office furniture, high-end décor, or specialized business equipment, our team delivers every piece with professionalism, precision, and respect for your property. When quality, reliability, and presentation matter most, Prestige Moving’s specialized delivery services are the trusted choice for Ottawa businesses.

Specialized Delivery Services

Dock-to-Dock Delivery

Ideal for warehouses, distribution centers, and businesses transferring equipment or inventory between locations. Our dock-to-dock service ensures your goods arrive safely and on schedule.

White-Glove Delivery

For fragile or high-value items, our white-glove movers in Ottawa deliver premium service. We handle your valuables delicately, set them up in your new space, and remove all packaging so you can get back to business immediately.

Our Commercial Moving Process

We make commercial moving simple, transparent, and completely stress-free.

  1. Consultation & Planning – We start with a discussion to understand your timeline, layout, and relocation goals.

  2. Free, Transparent Quote – Receive a detailed quote with no hidden fees.

  3. Flexible Scheduling – Choose your preferred moving date, including after-hours options.

  4. Professional Moving Day Execution – Our team arrives on time, fully equipped, and ready to deliver a seamless experience.

  5. Optional Unpacking & Setup – We help set up your new workspace so you can get back to business fast.

Commercial Moves We Specialize In

We proudly provide commercial moving services in Ottawa for a wide range of industries:

  • Office Moving – Complete workspace relocations, from cubicles to executive suites.

  • Medical & Dental Clinics – Secure handling of specialized equipment and patient records.

  • Retail & Showroom Moves – Transportation of racks, displays, and POS systems.

  • Restaurants & Cafés – Moving kitchen equipment, furniture, and décor.

  • Industrial & Warehouse Moves – Safe relocation of shelving units, machinery, and tools.

Local & Long-Distance Commercial Moves

Whether you’re moving your business within Ottawa, expanding into Kanata, Nepean, Orleans, or Barrhaven, or relocating across Ontario or Quebec, Prestige Moving provides the expertise and logistics support to ensure a smooth transition.

Why Local Businesses Trust Prestige Moving

  • Fully licensed and insured commercial movers

  • Experienced, background-checked team

  • On-time arrivals and efficient execution

  • Transparent quotes with no hidden fees

  • Locally owned and operated right here in Ottawa

Frequently Asked Questions

1. How much do commercial movers in Ottawa cost?
The cost of a commercial move in Ottawa depends on several factors, including the size of your office, the amount of furniture or equipment being moved, the distance between locations, and any special handling requirements. At Prestige Moving, we provide free, transparent quotes with no hidden fees so you’ll know exactly what to expect before moving day.

2. Do you provide after-hours or weekend office moving services?
Yes, absolutely. We understand that your business can’t afford extended downtime, so we offer flexible scheduling, including evening and weekend commercial moving services across Ottawa. Our goal is to complete your relocation while keeping your operations running smoothly and without interruption. Contact us for details.

3. Are your commercial movers licensed and insured?
Yes. Prestige Moving is a fully licensed and insured moving company. Our team of professional movers is trained to handle commercial relocations safely and responsibly, giving you peace of mind that your assets are protected from start to finish.

4. What types of commercial properties do you move?
We specialize in office, retail, restaurant, medical, warehouse, and industrial relocations throughout Ottawa and the surrounding areas. Whether you’re moving a small local office or an entire corporate facility, our team has the experience, equipment, and logistics expertise to handle it.

5. How far in advance should I schedule my commercial move?
For the best availability, we recommend booking your move at least 2 to 4 weeks in advance, especially during peak moving seasons (spring and summer). However, if you’re facing a tight deadline, contact us — our Ottawa moving team often accommodates last-minute commercial relocations when possible.

Get a Free Quote for Your Commercial Move

Planning a commercial relocation in Ottawa? Don’t leave it to chance — trust the experts at Prestige Moving for a seamless, professional experience.

Customized Antique Moving Solutions

  • Every antique has a story, and at Prestige Moving, we ensure that each piece continues its journey safely. Our customized moving solutions are crafted to address the unique requirements of your valuable items, providing peace of mind that they are treated with the respect and attention they deserve.
 

Specialized Packing for Unmatched Protection

  • We offer specialized packing services, employing the use of superior materials and techniques to safeguard your antiques. Each piece, from ornate mirrors to grand pianos, receives a tailored packing strategy to ensure it is protected throughout its transit.
 

Climate-Controlled Transportation

  • Our fleet features climate-controlled vehicles that are essential for the safe transport of sensitive antiques. We maintain optimal conditions to protect your items from temperature and humidity extremes, ensuring their preservation every mile of the way.
 

White-Glove Delivery Service

  • Upon arrival, our white-glove service ensures that your antiques are delivered with the utmost care. We handle the placement and setup of your pieces in your new location, taking every precaution to maintain their condition and integrity.
 

Premium Moving Supplies Designed for Antiques

  • We provide the highest quality moving supplies necessary for the secure transport of antiques. For clients who prefer to pre-pack their items, we can supply these specialized materials well in advance of your move.
 

Secure Storage for Valued Pieces

  • If you require storage for your antiques, Prestige Moving offers secure, climate-controlled storage solutions. Our facilities are perfectly suited for both short-term and long-term storage, providing a safe haven for your antiques until you are ready to place them in their new home.
 

Expert Disassembly and Reassembly

  • Our comprehensive services include the careful disassembly and reassembly of antique furniture and other complex items. Our skilled technicians are adept at handling these delicate tasks, ensuring your antiques are moved without compromising their historical value.
 

The Trusted Name in Antique Moving

  • Prestige Moving is honored to be the trusted partner for antique collectors, enthusiasts, and homeowners across Ottawa. We are dedicated to upholding the legacy of your antiques with every move we make.
 

Choose Prestige Moving for Your Antique Relocation Needs

  • For a move that treats your antiques with the honor they deserve, turn to Prestige Moving. Our dedicated antique moving services are at your disposal, providing a seamless and dignified relocation experience. Reach out to us today to discuss your antique moving needs and to schedule a detailed consultation.

item.excerpt:encoded: At Prestige Moving, we specialize in antique moving services in Ottawa, ensuring your priceless heirlooms, delicate furniture, and fragile collectibles are transported with the utmost care. Our expert movers use custom padding, secure wrapping, and climate-controlled trucks to protect your antiques from damage during transit. Whether you’re relocating a vintage piano, fine art, or a delicate china cabinet, we handle every item with precision and care.
